noReference.quote: | Text-to-video (T2V) | Only `prompt` and common fields | Generates from text |
noReference.interpretation: Pure text intent: no image, video or audio assets.

first_frame_image.quote: Public image URL used as the video's first frame.

last_frame_image.quote: Public image URL used as the video's last frame. It can be used alone or together with `first_frame_image`.

image_urls.quote: Together with reference images in `image_with_roles`, at most `9` images.

video_urls.quote: At most `3` clips, each `2`–`15` seconds, with a combined reference-video duration of at most `15` seconds.

audio_urls.quote: At most `3` clips, each `2`–`15` seconds, with a combined reference-audio duration of at most `15` seconds.

exclusive.quote: First/last-frame fields cannot be combined with reference media.
